comment: Thread definition consumed by a shell loop; see usage below.
usage: ARGS=(); while IFS= read -r p; do ARGS+=(--part "$p"); done < <(jq -r '.parts[]' schedule-thread.json); superx scheduled:create "${ARGS[@]}" --at "$(jq -r '.scheduled_for' schedule-thread.json)"
parts: 1/ Most accounts do not have a content problem. They have a distribution problem.
2/ The For You feed rewards posts that trigger replies, shares, and profile visits. Likes alone barely move the needle.
3/ So before you post, ask one question: would a stranger reply to this? If not, rewrite the hook.
4/ That single filter, applied daily, changes everything. What is the last post you replied to, and why?
